newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: U.S. soldier arrested in S. Korea arms case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soldier arrested in S. Korea arms case.

text.p: South Korean police said on Thursday they had arrested a United States army sergeant on suspicion of smuggling automatic rifles out of a U.S. military base.
An police statement said he was caught selling four automatic rifles to South Korean arms dealers in Choong-chung province south of Seoul on Wednesday.
The base was not identified and U.S. military authorities in South Korea were not available for comment.
Police said eight Koreans were also arrested.
The case comes as U.S. defence secretary William Cohen prepares to arrive in Seoul next Wednesday for talks with South Korean leaders.

It also appears to be a new Asian embarrassment for the U.S. military after the arrest this week in Japan of a sailor on suspicion of beating and sexually assaulting his Japanese girlfriend in his quarters.
The South Korean police statement said police were tipped off in late March about rifle sales and smuggling from U.S. bases in South Korea.
Under current agreements between the U.S. military and South Korea, the military have custody of soldiers accused of committing crimes until their trial is completed.
